summary: Fall back when an Array-producing method can invoke a custom @@species constructor with observable user code.

target.notes: ArraySpeciesCreate can execute user-defined constructor/species getters and constructors. Runtime handling must preserve their side effects, exceptions, and returned-object behavior.

caveats: Do not force a builtin Array result when Symbol.species is customized.
Change-by-copy methods such as toReversed, toSorted, toSpliced, and with create intrinsic Arrays and do not use ArraySpeciesCreate.

tests.name: slice invokes custom species
tests.input: class A extends Array { static get [Symbol.species]() { console.log('species'); return Array; } } new A(1,2).slice(0);
tests.notes: The species getter runs before slice returns.

tests.name: species getter may throw
tests.input: class A extends Array { static get [Symbol.species]() { throw new Error('x'); } } try { new A(1).slice(); } catch(e) { console.log(e.message); }
